Build and maintain your own plan; bring the preparations through to reconciled invoices and thank-you messages.

Deposit: 25% ($600) at signing secures the date. Balance ($1,800) due ten days before the event.
Overtime: $150 per additional half hour, only by written agreement with the client.
Valid until November 15, 2026.
Riverside Lodge: Riverside room with covered terrace, evening of December 12, 2026: $2,900. Deposit 25% ($725) to book.

Dana Whitfield
Events coordinator, Orchard Hall

Riverside Lodge events team

emails.subject: Wedding: first quotes
emails.body:
Hi El,

The quotes are in. Orchard Hall is $2,400 for 1 to 10 pm with tables, chairs and linen (their quote is in Project). Riverside is $2,900; the extra is a terrace we won't use in December. Orchard Food Co., the hall's usual caterer, says about $42 a head for a buffet and will send a proposal. Guest list v3 is 40 people.

Dana can show us the hall on Sunday November 8 at 11:00. Please put it in both our calendars and ask her to hold the 12th for us until then.

Alex
